top_choice_rationale: The GLP-1 proposal rewards a mature, clinically transformative line of work: the physiology of GLP-1 and the identification of its active forms (Drucker, Holst, Mojsov) that made incretin-based therapy of type 2 diabetes and obesity possible. The citation is scoped to the foundational discoveries, the three-laureate allocation fits the limit, and the therapeutic impact is established at scale. An award is clearly preferable to no award.
